title: Khelat Bhawan Website Dashboard
instructions: Choose a section from the left menu.
Open an item, update only the information or media that needs changing, then select Publish.
Use Show on website to temporarily hide an item without deleting it.
For events, update the date, availability and Allow enquiry button. Payments and automated bookings are not enabled.
Add booked, held or closed dates under Unavailable Reservation Dates.
Every website enquiry is saved under Enquiries and emailed to the official Khelat Bhawan address. The visitor receives a confirmation that the team will connect within 48 hours.
After replying to an enquiry, change its status from New to Contacted and add a private note if useful.
For Google reviews, always paste the original review text and the direct link to that exact review.
The website layout, colours, fonts and animations are locked and cannot be changed from this dashboard.
publishingNote: A saved draft is not visible on the public website until you select Publish. Review dates, spelling, images and links before publishing.

address: 47, Pathuria Ghata Street, Jorasanko, Kolkata, West Bengal 700006
seoDescription: Discover Khelat Bhawan, the historic Pathuria Ghata Ghosh Bari and its living legacy of devotion, culture and community in Kolkata.

heritageHeading.en: This house isn't bricks and walls—it is Bengal's cultural soul.
heritageHeading.bn: এই বাড়ি শুধু ইট ও দেয়াল নয়—এটি বাংলার সাংস্কৃতিক আত্মা।

heritageCopy.en: Established in 1845, Khelat Bhawan stands as a living testament to Bengali cultural heritage and spiritual devotion.
heritageCopy.bn: ১৮৪৫ সালে প্রতিষ্ঠিত খেলাৎ ভবন বাংলা সংস্কৃতি ও আধ্যাত্মিক ঐতিহ্যের এক জীবন্ত নিদর্শন।
